mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 250.0 (1982-1984=100), it signals persistent high inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 thousand units and real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 500,000 million dollars signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 500000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), the labor market tightness supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 110.0 (2017=100), it indicates robust manufacturing and supply chain activity, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 110.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate stronger residential construction activity, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to higher interest rates and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceed 150,000 thousand persons, it signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 150000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
